label: Bible Study
prompt: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good _____, and do it.
verse: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
note: Ezra was on his face weeping over the people's sin — Shechaniah tells him to get up, take heart, and lead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Every word of God is _____: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verse: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
note: Agur's proverb: every word of God is pure, and He is a shield to all who trust Him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's _____; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
verse: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
note: Goliath's spear shaft was like a weaver's beam — the giant came armed with what looked like a loom part.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In your _____ possess ye your souls.
verse: In your patience possess ye your souls.
note: Jesus' counsel amid predicted wars and betrayals: you keep your soul by enduring, not by escaping.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore let him that thinketh he _____ take heed lest he fall.
verse: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
note: Right after recounting Israel's wilderness failures: 'let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.'
